newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama consumer prices rise 0.3 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Panama consumer prices rise 0.3 pct in September.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index rose 0.3 percent in September, up from zero percent in September 1995 and up from 0.2 percent in August this year, the Comptroller General office said.

September's rise brought inflation over the past 12 months to 1.0 percent compared with 1.2 percent in the year to September 1995, it said in a release. Cumulative inflation for the first nine months of the year now stands at 0.9 percent.
Economists attribute Panama's low inflation primarily to its use of the U.S. dollar as national currency and longstanding wage and price control policies.
